text: As an immigrant child, I watched my parents work multiple jobs and long shifts to build our family's American Dream in Milpitas. They taught me that our community is built on hard work and looking out for one another. As a mother, caregiver, frontline healthcare worker, union member, and labor leader, I stand with working families. Today, as my children walk the same high school halls I once did, I feel a responsibility to protect and uplift the home that gave my family everything. Like many residents, I want safe neighborhoods with adequate lighting; well-maintained parks and fields where sports can be played safely; reliable public services supported by the staff who deliver them; and affordable, stable housing for seniors, people with special needs, city employees, and public safety workers who commute hours to serve Milpitas. As a healthcare worker, I lead with compassion and conviction and see families' needs firsthand. City decisions affect families, seniors, small businesses, and workers, and those perspectives should guide policy choices. Our city government should listen to the people it serves. I will collaborate transparently, seek residents' input, and lead with solutions. Join me in keeping Milpitas safe, welcoming, and affordable for everyone.

text: Serving on the Milpitas Planning Commission from 2019 to 2024, including as Chair and Vice-Chair, gave me firsthand experience balancing responsible growth, fiscal responsibility, and community needs. Today, I serve on the Valley Water Independent Monitoring Committee, Milpitas Veterans Commission, Milpitas CERT, and Milpitas Kiwanis, while chairing the MUSD Community Board Advisory Council and Parcel Tax Oversight Committee.

Raised in an immigrant family with six children, I learned hard work, discipline, and service. My commitment began as a Boy Scout and Boys State delegate, continued through active duty in the United States Army as an armor crewman, and led to a Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering from Cal Poly, San Luis Obispo.

A proud Milpitas resident for nearly 20 years, my family is deeply rooted here. My wife serves on the MUSD Board of Education. Two of our children attend Milpitas High, and one attends UC Santa Cruz. As your Councilmember, my priority is public safety, advocating for responsible affordable housing, and investing in infrastructure to improve our quality of life. Amid staffing challenges and budget uncertainty at City Hall, I will apply sound financial management and practical problem-solving while being transparent to protect taxpayer dollars.
I respectfully ask for your vote. Visit billchuanformilpitas.com.

text: Milpitas is a city of opportunity, innovation, and hardworking families. I am an immigrant and a proud 30-year Milpitas resident. I serve as your Planning Commissioner and formerly served on the Economic Development and Trade Commission, which allowed me to apply successful business strategies to government bureaucracy.

As a successful retired small-business owner, I know how to promote and grow businesses. I operated an essential market for more than a decade. During COVID, I worked every day on the retail floor to keep families supplied, supported my employees, and later volunteered to pick up litter on Milpitas streets.

I bring real-world experience in government and business, sound budgeting, and financial responsibility. As a Planning Commissioner, I helped advance responsible business growth, well-paying jobs, smart infrastructure, and safe neighborhoods.

As your Councilmember, I will focus on essential services: clean streets, well-maintained parks, safer neighborhoods, and infrastructure that works. I will streamline permits, help deliver affordable housing, and address homelessness with dignity and compassion.
Milpitas deserves an accessible and accountable Councilmember who understands residents, public safety, and local businesses.
I humbly ask for your vote. Endorsed by Mayor Carmen Montano and Councilmembers Evelyn Chua and William Lam. www.dipakawasthi.org

text: Hello, Milpitas! As your Vice Mayor, attorney, and fellow resident, I am Garry Barbadillo, and I humbly ask for your vote. My journey from immigrant to public servant is rooted in gratitude. Milpitas is where my wife and I chose to raise our children, and serving our community is my way of giving back.
Bringing legal expertise, practical governance experience, and over a decade of pro bono community service, I was honored to be named Milpitas Citizen of the Year in 2018.

During my Council tenure, I have consistently protected your budget—managing tax dollars responsibly without increasing costs on families. Public safety remains my top priority; I consistently fund police and emergency services to keep our streets safe while protecting senior programs and neighborhood quality of life. Regionally, I advocate for Milpitas on key water, green energy, and emergency communications boards and I have represented our city in Valley Water, Silicon Valley Clean Energy, and the Silicon Valley Regional Interoperability Authority.
I remain dedicated to transparent governance, responsive public services, and building a prosperous future for all residents. I respectfully ask for your continued trust and your vote.
